minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version Enforced
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS/SSL protocol version enforced by the cloud storage service, gateway, or endpoint. Deprecated versions expose traffic to downgrade and cipher attacks.

tls_version_policy_enforced.title: TLS Minimum Version Policy Enforced
tls_version_policy_enforced.description: Whether an explicit policy actively rejects connections attempting to negotiate deprecated TLS/SSL versions.

accepted_tls_versions.title: Accepted TLS Protocol Versions
accepted_tls_versions.description: List of TLS/SSL protocol versions the endpoint will accept during negotiation. Presence of deprecated versions enables downgrade attacks.

certificate_chain_validation_enabled.title: Certificate Chain Validation Enabled
certificate_chain_validation_enabled.description: Whether the client validates the full certificate chain up to a trusted root CA when connecting to cloud storage endpoints.

hostname_verification_enabled.title: Hostname Verification Enabled
hostname_verification_enabled.description: Whether the client verifies that the server certificate CN or SAN matches the target hostname when connecting to cloud storage.

certificate_revocation_check_method.title: Certificate Revocation Check Method
certificate_revocation_check_method.description: The method used to check whether server certificates have been revoked before trusting them. none indicates revocation checking is absent.

allows_self_signed_certificates.title: Allows Self-Signed Certificates
allows_self_signed_certificates.description: Whether the client is configured to accept self-signed certificates from cloud storage endpoints without further chain validation.

mtls_enabled.title: Mutual TLS Authentication Enabled
mtls_enabled.description: Whether mutual TLS (mTLS) is configured, requiring both client and server to present and validate certificates during the TLS handshake.

client_certificate_validation_mode.title: Client Certificate Validation Mode
client_certificate_validation_mode.description: The mode used to validate client certificates during TLS handshake. none means no client cert requested, optional means requested but not enforced, required means mandatory and validated.

trusted_client_ca_configured.title: Trusted Client CA Certificate Configured
trusted_client_ca_configured.description: Whether a trusted CA bundle is configured for validating client certificates. Without this, client certificate validation cannot be cryptographically enforced.

weak_cipher_suite_accepted.title: Weak or Deprecated Cipher Suite Accepted
weak_cipher_suite_accepted.description: Whether the TLS endpoint accepts at least one weak, null, export-grade, or cryptographically broken cipher suite (RC4, NULL, EXPORT, DES, 3DES, anon DH, DHE <1024-bit).

negotiated_cipher_suites.title: Negotiated TLS Cipher Suites
negotiated_cipher_suites.description: List of cipher suites accepted or negotiated during TLS handshake. Used to detect presence of RC4, NULL, EXPORT, anon, DES cipher families.

pfs_enforcement_enabled.title: PFS-Only Cipher Suite Enforcement
pfs_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether the TLS configuration explicitly restricts cipher suites to only those providing Perfect Forward Secrecy (ECDHE or DHE key exchange). True means non-PFS suites are blocked.

hsts_header_present.title: HSTS Header Present
hsts_header_present.description: Whether the server responds with a Strict-Transport-Security header on HTTPS responses.

hsts_max_age_seconds.title: HSTS max-age Value (seconds)
hsts_max_age_seconds.description: The max-age directive value in the Strict-Transport-Security header. Values below 31536000 (one year) are insufficient. Set to 0 if header is absent.

session_ticket_rotation_enabled.title: Session Ticket Key Rotation Enabled
session_ticket_rotation_enabled.description: Whether TLS session ticket keys are rotated on a scheduled basis to limit the window of compromise if a ticket key is leaked.

session_resumption_max_lifetime_seconds.title: Maximum TLS Session Resumption Lifetime (seconds)
session_resumption_max_lifetime_seconds.description: The maximum allowed lifetime in seconds for a TLS session ticket or session ID. Values above 86400 (24 hours) indicate excessive exposure.

session_resumption_mechanism.title: TLS Session Resumption Mechanism
session_resumption_mechanism.description: The type of TLS session resumption mechanism in use for connections to cloud storage endpoints.

shared_ticket_key_across_instances.title: Session Ticket Key Shared Across Multiple Instances
shared_ticket_key_across_instances.description: Whether the same static session ticket key is distributed across multiple servers or instances without secure key management, increasing blast radius if compromised.

application_layer_integrity_enabled.title: Application-Layer Integrity Verification Enabled
application_layer_integrity_enabled.description: Whether application-layer message integrity mechanisms (HMAC signatures, digital signatures, cryptographic checksums) are applied to data payloads independently of TLS.

tls_termination_points.title: TLS Termination Points
tls_termination_points.description: List of intermediate nodes (CDN, reverse proxy, load balancer, API gateway) where TLS is terminated and re-established before reaching the cloud storage backend.

payload_checksum_validation_enforced.title: Payload Checksum Validation Enforced
payload_checksum_validation_enforced.description: Whether the storage service or application enforces validation of cryptographic checksums on received payloads, detecting tampering between TLS hops before data is committed.

rpki_route_origin_validation_enabled.title: RPKI Route Origin Validation Enabled
rpki_route_origin_validation_enabled.description: Whether Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) route origin validation is configured and enforced for BGP routes serving cloud storage endpoints.

bgp_path_monitoring_enabled.title: BGP Autonomous System Path Monitoring Enabled
bgp_path_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether active monitoring of BGP autonomous system paths is in place to detect unexpected route changes or anomalous AS paths for cloud storage traffic.

unexpected_asn_hops_detected.title: Unexpected Autonomous System Hops Detected
unexpected_asn_hops_detected.description: Whether traffic analysis or route inspection has identified unexpected or anomalous autonomous system numbers in the path to cloud storage endpoints, indicating a potential prefix hijack.

dnssec_validation_enabled.title: DNSSEC Validation Enabled
dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Whether DNSSEC validation is enforced for DNS resolution of cloud storage endpoints, ensuring DNS responses are cryptographically signed and authentic.

encrypted_dns_protocol.title: Encrypted DNS Protocol
encrypted_dns_protocol.description: The DNS transport protocol used when resolving cloud storage endpoints. Indicates whether DNS queries are protected from interception or manipulation in transit.

certificate_pinning_enabled.title: Certificate Pinning or Strict HSTS Enabled
certificate_pinning_enabled.description: Whether the client enforces certificate pinning or HSTS preloading for cloud storage endpoints, preventing acceptance of fraudulent certificates served by a DNS-spoofed host.

api_rate_limiting_enabled.title: API Rate Limiting Enabled
api_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether per-client or per-session bandwidth throttling and request rate limiting is enforced on data transfer API endpoints.

max_transfer_rate_bytes_per_second.title: Maximum Transfer Rate (Bytes/Second)
max_transfer_rate_bytes_per_second.description: The configured per-client maximum data transfer rate in bytes per second. Zero or null indicates no limit is set.

encrypted_client_hello_enabled.title: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) Enabled
encrypted_client_hello_enabled.description: Whether the TLS client is configured to use Encrypted Client Hello, preventing SNI from being transmitted in cleartext during the TLS handshake.
